title: Use AI for Spreadsheet Formulas Without Breaking Your Sheet
description: AI can draft an Excel or Google Sheets formula, but don't paste the first answer into your live workbook. Explain what each column means, ask for the formula and its assumptions, then test a normal row, a blank row, and an edge case. In this illustrative example, $1,000 multiplied by 5% should return $50. If the result is $5,000, inspect whether the percentage was entered as 5 instead of 5%. Test on a copy before filling the formula down. Professor Mia shares practical AI habits using synthetic sample data.
